notes.title: VN Fest + DLC release + KS prelaunch
notes.notes:
[h3]We've got an exciting month ahead of us this March![/h3]

First off, Wrong Number is taking part in Visual Novel Fest this week! 
A celebration of amazing visual novel style games, focused on story telling, beautiful artwork, and meaningful choices. 
Get the Wrong Number game at a 20% discount until March 11th (AEST).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981281/c60667f3f564e9678993eec44bfab5c8bc5ac5ce.png[/img]

Second order of news, today we've released two of our short story ebooks!
These two short and spicy stories take place directly after the events of the Wrong Number game. They follow Luka and Xander after they've began a physical relationship and are honestly more of an indulgence than anything. Haha. 
Both stories launched with a 40% discount to celebrate their release here on Steam. 
[b][i]Please be aware, these are NOT visual novel games, they are ebooks. Check the provided screenshot on their pages for preview.[/i][/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511280/Wrong_Number__Going_69_in_a_50_zone_ebook/][b]>> Going 69 in a 50 zone <<[/b][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981281/4db05814232c0fd1c2de042e51de14e266777269.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511290/Wrong_Number__On_the_69th_day_of_Xmas_ebook/?beta=0][b]>> On the 69th day of Xmas <<[/b][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981281/54da224539b1ff8bea9ac4f8738fc1e10908ad60.png[/img]


Third and final news, we're launching a KS campaign to fund the art in our next project!
If you're as invested on Luka and Xander's relationship as I am (to a possibly unhealthy obsession, if I'm being honest) and the game wasn't enough for you... well, good news!
We're releasing a 30,000+ word novella book this year! This time the story is mostly written from Xander's POV and shows readers just how much he actually wants to be with Luka. And I mean, [i]really [/i]want to be with him. 
This KS campaign is aimed to fund the art for the book, and also gives fans a chance to snag some awesome physical goodies. It goes live on March 11th (AEST) but will run until mid-April.
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/witpop/just-69cm-between-us-a-yaoi-light-novel-set-in-australia?ref=esuhis][b]>> Follow to be notified when we go LIVE <<[/b][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981281/0ee1696f5f8420674d279139fa842baa7afc521f.png[/img]

notes.title: Upcoming festival and DLC release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981281/1e64ee1a68964636367a7fd93d6dd49cb103be58.png[/img]

This year we'll be part of [b][i]The Storyteller's Festival[/i][/b], hosted by [b]Two and a Half Studios[/b]. 

[i][b]The Storyteller's Festival[/b][/i] is a celebration of the art of storytelling, featuring a wide range of visual novels and narrative games that showcase the best in interactive fiction.

To celebrate, we're releasing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383300/Wrong_Number__Artbook_and_Guide/?beta=0]Wrong Number Artbook and Guide[/url] on the day of the festival, with a super awesome launch discount of 40%. Woohoo! Don't forget to wishlist it if you're interested to learn what went on behind-the-scenes of developing Wrong Number. 

After the festival we're also planning to release a couple of ebook DLCs in March. These are short stories that take place after the events of the game. If you like silly (and spicy) yaoi stories, then stay tuned.

And as a final reminder, don't forget to leave a review on our store page to help boost our visibility. I've been so grateful to the 4 reviews we've gotten so far, and the kind comments honestly warm my heart ːsteamhappyː Positive reviews motivate and encourage me to continue making more silly bromance stories between Luka and Xander, haha. 

Happy Gaming!

Red

Wrong Number is releasing tomorrow!

notes.title: Official Steam Release Date
notes.notes:
Put it in your calendars! Set yourself a reminder! 

[h1]Wrong Number will be releasing on Tuesday the 5th of November 2024 (AEST)[/h1]

In less than a week, players will be able to play as Luka, a carefree guy that just likes to have fun. And what's more fun that convincing a stranger you meet over the phone to come hang out with you? 
Will Luka and Xander's relationship grow into something sweet and romantic? Or be purely physical in nature? 

I'm so excited to share this game with more people and hope players enjoy the silly banter between characters.
